newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Spartech estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Spartech estimates raised.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial Inc said Thursday it raised its 1997 earnings estimate for Spartech Corp to $0.88 a share from $0.86 and its estimate for 1997 to $1.00 a share from $0.98.

-- Mesirow said the move follows strong performances by all three of Spartech's operating units, which drove first-quarter earnings to $0.20 a share, above Mesirow's expectations of $0.18 for the period.
-- Spartech was able to control operating expense growth and efficiently assimilate the Portage Industries and Hamelin Group business it recently acquired, Mesirow said.
-- Spartech makes extruded plastic sheet used by other manufacturers and other plastic products.
-- Its shares were off 1/8 Thursday afternoon at 11-5/8.
